You acted all friendly and set up a seaweed bed\nfor us just so you could trap us while we were\nfast asleep?!
You even used "moss ball fragrance" to weaken us!\nThat's low! What, are you too scared to fight us\nhead-on?!
Hey, be quiet!\nYou're making too much noise! It will attract\nmonsters!
You all are gonna be executed here anyway!\nSo just prepare yourselves!
...Where is Sir Unda?\nWhat happened to him?
He's still alive, but...
He's tied up in that "Raden Tower" over there.
What?!
Getting eaten alive by a "Gourmet" like that has\nto be the worst punishment you can ever imagine.
Looks like His Majesty is really furious.\nSure, Unda abandoned the royal family and left,\nbut you don't do that to your own brother...
Darn it! Set us free! We're going to rescue Sir\nUnda!
Hmph, what can you even do to help him?\nYou lot don't stand a chance against the\n"Gourmet"!
Besides, do you even understand how much trouble\nyou're in right now?
This Nebbia Coast is teeming with "Rana-eating"\nmonsters. They're not as vicious as the "Gourmet",\nbut if you make too much noise, they'll come.
Now tell us what exactly that "Gourmet" thing\nyou're talking about!
W-who the hey are you?!
We've met before, haven't we?!\nPlease, help us! Sir Unda is in danger!
Ugh, I got a really strong feeling that we're\nabout to get dragged into something troublesome.\nWhat do we do now?
Well, I knew you'd say so.\nIt's not like we don't know you, there's no way we\nwould abandon you~.
Rraaa, rraaagh!!
Whoaa!!
It's Rondine!!\nThat pesky creature has shown up!!
What the hey is this giant bird?!
Tch, it's attacking everything it sees!\nHey, we need to stop it!
Sorry for the trouble, and thanks for saving our\nday!
That bird is called Rondine. It's a terrifying\nmonster that preys on Ranas.
I can't believe you beat it. Thank you...
If you're really grateful to us, can you do us a\nfavor?
A favor?
We want you to free those soldiers over there.\nThey've probably done something wrong, but they're\nour friends.
You can use this key to free them. Do whatever you\nlike with them.
Awesome! I knew you'd understand!
We didn't agree simply because you helped us.\nThe truth is, ever since the current king came to\npower, our kingdom has been a total mess.
We're sick of following ridiculous orders.
Well then, thanks for your help.
Looks like the king of Unda's kingdom isn't very\nwell-liked.
Let's try asking those chumps who got caught so\neasily about that.
Oh, thanks for saving us! Those chosen by Sir Unda\nnever disappoint!
After seeing your fight with that bird monster,\nI'm convinced! We're no match for the "Gourmet"!\nPlease, save Sir Unda!
Not that name again.\nWhat exactly is that "Gourmet" thing?
It's the sea monster, Gula. It's a creature that\nour homeland, the undersea kingdom "Raela", takes\ncare of.
It's called that because it devours anything\nindiscriminately. Ranas, Eumanos, weredragons, or\neven strange species from different dimensions.
Aye! Lixis should also be on the menu!
Shut up, you'll just make things complicated!
It's huge and ferocious. According to our records,\nthe only time it was ever defeated was when it\nfled from Kova, the legendary Rana hero.
It seems that the king of Raela, Fubla, who is\nalso Sir Unda's older brother by blood, plans to\nfeed him to that monster! It's a cruel punishment!
Looks like Unda's attempt to convince the kingdom\ndidn't sit well, at least with the royal family~.
We need to go save the others! And there's no way\nwe can beat the "Gourmet", so please!\nRescue sir Unda!
Oh, you're really gonna help?! Thanks a million!
Welp, since Mare asked us too, I guess we don't\nreally have a choice.
It's good to be optimistic, but the real question\nis, do we even know where Unda is?
He's in a prison called "Raden Tower"!\nThe building really stands out along the\ncoastline.
Powerful monsters under the Gourmet's spell are\nroaming around inside. Be careful!
Aye, aye! Got it!
Well, we're counting on you!
Alright, shall we go too?\nWe prolly don't have much time left!
Oh~, I have a feeling that this assignment from\nMare is gonna cost us big time!
